label: ناصر — نجدي
ref_text: أهلين يا أخوي صالح، أنا أنس من معارض الديرة. الله يسلمك، كيف حالك اليوم؟
source: omnivoice-finetune/data/najdi_mix_v3/wavs/8da9f4db2b57.wav (id najdi_v3_8da9f4db2b57: in the v3 test split, so the shipped najdi_mix_v3_ft checkpoint never trained on it; older runs did)
notes: Nasser AlJubaily, Najdi male support agent: a cheerful agent greeting at his natural pace. Chosen over longer clips because the clone copies the reference's pace: cloned with the omnivoice_najdi model (najdi_mix_v3_ft/checkpoint-1950), it speaks at 11.1-11.6 letters/s, his median is 11.3, where the previous 17 s clip gave 8.5-9.3. It also gave the most Nasser-like output of the candidates (similarity 0.914) and scores UTMOS 3.68 itself (his recordings average 3.42). The omnivoice_najdi model always clones this voice; the other models can pick it too.
